title: AssistantEvalSuite
description: The baseline eval suite of one catalog assistant version: the base it belongs to, the classification threshold and the install values runs render with. The fixtures live beside it in fixtures.jsonl (assistant-eval-fixture.schema.json). See docs/assistants/adr-forks.md, Promotion.

minClassification.description: Fixtures that must classify correctly in a full run.

values.description: Install values, as an AssistantInstall's spec.values.
